message.content:
I don’t have direct access to your machine, so I can’t tell you for sure whether VS Code is running right now.  
But you can check it yourself with a quick command.

### On Windows (Command Prompt)

```cmd
tasklist | findstr /i "Code.exe"
```

If VS Code is running, you’ll see a line that looks something like:

```
Code.exe                 1234 Console                    1     45,678 K
```

If nothing appears, the process isn’t running.

### On Windows (PowerShell)

```powershell
Get-Process -Name Code -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
```

Again, if VS Code is running you’ll get a process object; otherwise you’ll get nothing.

---

If you’d like me to run one of those commands for you (e.g., to confirm the status), just let me know and I’ll execute it for you.
